abstract: This paper investigates how telecommunications infrastructure affects economic growth. This issue is important and has received considerable attention in the popular press concerning the creation of the 'information superhighway' and its potential impacts on the economy. We use evidence from 21 OECD countries over a twenty-year period to examine the impacts that telecommunications developments may have had. We estimate a structural model, which endogenizes telecommunication investment by specifying a micro-model of supply and demand for telecommunication investments. The micro-model is then jointly estimated with the macro-growth equation. After controlling for country-specific fixed effects, we find evidence of a significant positive causal link, especially when a critical mass of telecommunications infrastructure is present. Interestingly, the critical mass appears to be at a level of telecommunications infrastructure that is near universal service.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨电信基础设施如何影响经济增长。这一问题至关重要，且因"信息高速公路"的构建及其对经济的潜在影响，已在主流媒体中引发广泛关注。我们利用21个OECD国家二十年的数据，考察电信发展可能产生的影响。通过构建一个将电信投资内生化处理的微观供需模型，我们对该结构模型进行估计。该微观模型与宏观增长方程联合估计后，在控制国家固定效应的情况下，发现电信基础设施与经济增长之间存在显著的正向因果关联——尤其当电信基础设施达到临界规模时更为明显。值得注意的是，这一临界规模恰好接近实现普遍服务的电信基础设施水平。
title: Telecommunications Infrastructure And Economic Development: A Simultaneous Approach
title_zh: 电信基础设施与经济发展：一种联立方法

abstract: We study frictionless matching models in large production economies with and without market imperfections and/or incentive problems. We provide necessary and sufficient distribution-free conditions for monotone matching which depend on the relationship between what we call the segregation payoff - a generalization of the individually rational payoff - and the feasible set for a pair of types. Imperfections have two distinct effects that are relevant for equilibrium matching patterns: they can overwhelm the complementarity properties of the production technology and they can introduce nontransferabilities that make equilibrium matching inefficient. We also use our framework to reveal the source of differences in the comparative static properties of some models in the literature and to explore the effects of distribution on the equilibrium matching pattern.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在存在或不存在市场缺陷及/或激励问题的大型生产经济中的无摩擦匹配模型。我们提出了单调匹配的充分必要条件（无需分布假设），这些条件取决于我们称之为“隔离收益”（个体理性收益的推广）与一对类型的可行集之间的关系。市场缺陷对均衡匹配模式产生两种不同的影响：它们可能压倒生产技术的互补性特征，也可能引入非可转移性，导致均衡匹配效率低下。此外，我们利用该框架揭示了文献中某些模型比较静态性质差异的根源，并探讨了分布对均衡匹配模式的影响。
title: Monotone Matching In Perfect And Imperfect Worlds
title_zh: 完美与不完美世界中的单调匹配
